description.en: Daily industry-intelligence cockpit for retail stores and consumer brands: source-backed signals, buyer-intent interpretation, approved sales/merchandising actions, and channel drafts (staff brief / IG story / store sign) for review before any external handoff. Signals/actions/drafts enter Busabase only through the agent's own browsing-and-writing workflow (see SKILL.md); the AirApp itself is read/decision-only.
description.zh-CN: 面向零售门店与消费品牌的每日行业情报驾驶舱：有出处的情报信号、买家意向解读、经审批的销售/陈列运营动作，以及对外发出前待审的渠道文案草稿（店员简报 / IG 故事 / 门店海报）。信号、动作与草稿只通过 Agent 自身的浏览与写入流程进入 Busabase（见 SKILL.md）；AirApp 本身只负责查看与决策。

agentPrompts: Summarize the latest Signals and flag what needs my attention.
Open Busa Retail Intel and show me the items that need review.
